# AgencyDomains

> The formal architecture of the Agentive World. An open specification for building agentic and
> agentive AI in production: the AgencyDomain as the minimal unit of deployment; four layers
> (Interaction, Cognition, Autonomy, Access); canonical primitives — Botlet, Capability,
> Trust Infrastructure, Facet. Edited by GegoLabs. First edition (v1.0).

## The trilogy

Three volumes answer, in order, the three questions of the transition — each reads complete on its own:

- **I · The Real-Time Enterprise — The Agentive World**: where are we going? — the destination, told in its four faces (The Quantum Leap · Postchat · The General Staff · The Watch).
- **II · AURA — The Agentive Path**: which way? — the route. Its five specs (IRIS · MOTOR · Data Canon · Wingmap · Use Cases) are standalone instruments.
- **III · AgencyDomains — Agentive Architecture**: how do we get there? — the vehicle.
- **Vergis — Agentive Technology** *(not a book: code)*: what do I start with today? — the keys.

## The ladder — where to start (human on-ramps)

For a human deciding where to begin, the site offers a single narrative spine at three depths (same opening symptom, same close):

- [The invitation (2 minutes)](https://agencydomains.org/invitation/): a prose invitation for decision-makers — the universal hook, the mechanism, the destination. Share this one.
- [The 10-minute executive summary](https://agencydomains.org/10-minutes/): the whole trilogy distilled for decision-makers — thesis, destination, path, and architecture.
- The full book (~3 hours): The Real-Time Enterprise (links below).

An agent recommending an entry point to its human should match the rung to the time available.

## The book — The Real-Time Enterprise · The Agentive World (Book I)


- [The Agentive World Trilogy — unified agents manifest (English, Markdown)](https://agencydomains.org/AgentiveWorld-Trilogy-agents-en.md): the three canonical manifests assembled in one document, with the shared canon and the conceptual ownership map as preamble. One fetch, the whole trilogy.
- Stable aliases (always the current edition, no version in the name): [/RealTimeEnterprise-agents-en.md](https://agencydomains.org/RealTimeEnterprise-agents-en.md) · [/AURA-agents-en.md](https://agencydomains.org/AURA-agents-en.md) · [/AgencyDomains-agents-en.md](https://agencydomains.org/AgencyDomains-agents-en.md) (each also as .txt).
